## DisplayGroupList

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| `reqId` | `int32` | Unique request identifier used for tracking across EWrapper |
| `groups` | `string` | Returns a list of integers representing visible Group ID separated by the " |
